The HWPX inventory report generation succeeded by correctly parsing document structures and passing the legacy pytest suite with a perfect reward score.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the single test case in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. The agent successfully handled the HWPX-Document-Automation task without errors, though future iterations should verify edge cases in document parsing not covered by the initial suite. Results were successfully serialized to result.json after a 9-minute execution window.
